sources.scope: Lily subtree only; independent lily/LICENSE and NOTICE retained.
Portable native Rust/Metal adaptation executed by a compatible agent; not a DisCo CLI/model run.

construction.method: User-approved native Rust/Metal and partial drafting adaptation; stable-ID lanes, integrated source graph and assertion/helper verification. Missing compiler/backend/checkpoint remains explicit.

applicability.scope: Exact Lily source/checkpoint/layout/API/cache/qualification investigation; common catalog classification is not CPU inference or cross-device support.
applicability.prerequisites: Access to the exact Lily source/model-layout/API contracts; native checks require the matching Rust/Metal/checkpoint environment and frozen comparison requirements.
applicability.input_contract: Source revision, Cargo lock/toolchain, macOS/chip/GPU family, checkpoint and tensor payload identities, affine configuration/layout, tokenizer/template/stops, sequence/output budgets, greedy policy, input history, prefix-cache state and quality/measurement requirements.
applicability.produced_artifact: A source/model/device-bound representation, serving-cache or qualification diagnosis with the observation, invariant, alternate cause, smallest falsifier, actual result and remaining native gap.
applicability.failure_modes: Equal bit width, file size, API names or prompt_cache_key do not establish tensor/token/state equivalence; ignoring the extra lookahead slot can understate request capacity, and green CPU references do not replace matched-model Metal goldens.
applicability.refusal_point: Stop at unsupported formats/APIs, missing compiler/backend/checkpoint, unfrozen gates or the authorized budget; do not weaken ignored/golden tests to obtain a green result.

limitations: Cargo/Rust1.92, supported M5/macOS26/Metal and model resources are unavailable; native evidence remains BLOCKED_REQUIRED_BACKEND.
Offline Python helper checks are not Rust serde/loader/tokenizer, native kernel/state/cache, model quality, service or performance validation.
Current benchmark source and later report have distinct package/harness identities; negative long-context prefill observations remain author-reported.
Only selected source bodies are mined; complete kernel/format/platform/failure coverage and behavioral skill efficacy remain unverified.
NO_LICENSE is the actual unauthenticated GitHub CLI fallback, not a legal conclusion; lily Apache-2.0 LICENSE and NOTICE are independently retained.
recommendations: Resolve exact affine representation and strict API semantics, then trace token frontier, cache key and restore/release ownership.
Retain the source's extra request lookahead slot in capacity arithmetic rather than counting only prompt and visible output.
Separate reported benchmark version from the checked-out runner and distinguish offline screening, native compilation, Metal operators and matched-model goldens.
